- `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3481-3482` | severity=high | confidence=5

  PROBLEM: The file defines test functions but lacks an `if __name__ == "__main__":` runner, so direct execution never runs the assertions.
  WHY: All reviewers reported the same silent-test-skip issue, and several cited CI’s direct `python3 tests/<file>.py` execution path.
- `tests/test_issue_pr_status_payload_fallback_contract.py` | severity=high | confidence=5

  PROBLEM: The file defines test functions but lacks an `if __name__ == "__main__":` runner, so direct execution never runs the assertions.
  WHY: All reviewers reported the same silent-test-skip issue, and several cited CI’s direct `python3 tests/<file>.py` execution path.
- `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview]
  PROBLEM: Repeated `jq` calls on the same PR JSON object waste processes and slow the orchestrator.
  WHY: Both reviewers identified the same performance issue in the same script; no other reviewer mentioned it, so it remains a single deduplicated finding with medium severity.
- `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview]
  PROBLEM: `_check_fresh_push_guard` only runs for `ai:done` and `ai:ready-to-merge`, leaving `ai:implementing` uncovered.
  WHY: Both reviewers described the same phase-coverage gap; severity was reported as medium/high-leaning, so the merged severity stays medium with the highest confidence.
- `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2]
  PROBLEM: The conflict-guard retry loop uses a fixed small retry window that may miss conflicts on slower repos.
  WHY: This was reported by only one reviewer, so it remains a singleton in consensus with the source reviewer’s confidence.

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===
- `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` | severity=5 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Multiple `jq` calls on the same JSON object waste processes.
  WHY: The review flagged repeated `printf '%s' "${linked_json}" | jq` calls in `_check_fresh_push_guard` and `_check_open_pr_conflict_guard`.
- `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` | severity=4 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `_check_fresh_push_guard` only runs for `ai:done` and `ai:ready-to-merge`, leaving `ai:implementing` exposed.
  WHY: The review said the guard does not cover the `ai:implementing` phase.
- `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` | severity=3 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The fixed retry loop in `run_standalone_stall_recovery` may fail to notice conflicts on slow repos.
  WHY: The review said the 5-attempt retry window can miss conflicts.
- `tests/test_label_helpers_phase_transition_contract.py`, `tests/test_issue_pr_status_payload_fallback_contract.py` | severity=5 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: No `if __name__ == "__main__":` block, so the tests do not run when executed directly.
  WHY: The review said CI runs these files directly and they exit without executing assertions.
- `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` | severity=5 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `source` command is not guarded, so a failing source aborts the step before fallback.
  WHY: The review said `set -e` makes the step exit before the fallback definitions can run.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===
- `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` | severity=5 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `source` command is executed blindly under `set -e`, so a sourcing failure aborts the step before fallback logic runs.
  WHY: The review said the file-exists check is insufficient and pointed to safer patterns elsewhere in the same workflow.
- `tests/test_label_helpers_phase_transition_contract.py`, `tests/test_issue_pr_status_payload_fallback_contract.py` | severity=5 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Missing `if __name__ == "__main__":` entry points mean the tests never run when executed directly.
  WHY: The review said CI executes these files via `python3 tests/<file>.py`, so they exit 0 without running assertions.
- `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` | severity=4 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Repeated `jq` calls on a single JSON variable violate the repo’s performance and API hygiene expectations.
  WHY: The review said multiple pipes on the same PR object unnecessarily spawn extra processes.
- `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` | severity=4 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `_check_fresh_push_guard` is only applied to `ai:done` and `ai:ready-to-merge`, leaving a race-condition gap.
  WHY: The review said the guard must also cover the `ai:implementing` phase to avoid redundant retrigger behavior.
